constraints: property accepts either a standard property name (a constant from the 'Menu Item Properties' theme, e.g. 4D_access_group, 4D_standard_action, 4D_execute_without_validating, 4D_start_new_process) or any custom string that does not begin with '4D_'; the accepted type/shape of value depends on which property is passed.

For the 'Associated standard action' standard property, value is a standard action name (Text) chosen from the Standard Action theme/Standard actions list; pre-4D v16 R3 code passing the deprecated Value for Associated Standard Action constants (Longint) is still supported for compatibility.
A custom property's value (Text, Longint, or Boolean) is stored with the menu item and can be retrieved with GET MENU ITEM PROPERTY.

If menu is a MenuRef, the command applies to all instances of the menu across all processes and process is ignored; if menu is a menu number, it applies to the main menu bar of the current process (or of process, if given).
Passing -1 in menuItem designates the last item added to menu.
If the menu item is the title of a hierarchical sub-menu, an associated standard action is not called when the item is selected.
